clock_lock_falsification.verdict: FALSIFIED. The degradation reproduced with SM clocks pinned and VERIFIED at ~2,490 MHz throughout - there was no clock collapse to prevent. The failure signature is now sharper: full clocks, 100 % utilization, ~44 W power draw (the busy-spin band), ~6,000 ms/token decode. The GPU is spinning at full clock without doing proportional work - consistent with a pipeline stall (memory/paravirtualization/synchronization), not with P-state or clock management. The expectation registered for a HEALTHY confirmed flight (power well above 45 W during active decode) was never met: power sat AT the ~44 W busy-spin band the whole window.
clock_lock_falsification.distinction_from_aug_14: the memorized Aug-14 pathology presented as clocks STUCK LOW (232 MHz, SW Power Cap, cool) and was fixed live by the lock; today's pathology presents at FULL locked clocks - these are different failure modes that share only the symptom of slow decode
